basic_details.job_title: MNLU Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Campus Administrator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: To be communicated by the University

age_limit.details: The age limit for the Campus Administrator post is preferably below 60 Years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | campus administrator: A Bachelor’s Degree from a recognised University. Minimum fifteen years of professional experience in defence or police service or any other equivalent administrative post in an Educational Institute is desirable. Preference will be given to ex-servicemen not below the rank of Lieutenant Colonel or equivalent rank in defence.

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated pay of ₹80,000/- per month with other benefits
salary_details.details: Other benefits include Provident Fund (12% of the consolidated pay), Rent Free Accommodation (equivalent to approximately ₹16,000/- per month) on the University Campus, and Medi-Claim Policy Reimbursement as admissible under the policy of the University. The gross salary along with entitlements is approximately ₹1,00,000/- per month.

selection_process: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applications followed by a personal interview with a Selection Committee through online mode.

Shortlisted eligible candidates will be called for a personal interview with a Selection Committee through online mode on the date and time to be communicated by the University. The Selection Committee will conduct an overall assessment of the candidates to check their suitability for the post.
how_to_apply: Prepare your latest CV along with all necessary supporting documents.
Draft an email addressed to the Registrar, Maharashtra National Law University, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.
Attach your latest CV and supporting documents to the email.
Send the email to the official email ID: [email protected].
Ensure the application via email reaches the University on or before 15th October, 2026.
important_instructions: Candidates who have already applied in response to the earlier notification dated 08.07.2026 are not required to apply afresh; their earlier applications will be considered. Mere fulfilment of the eligibility criteria does not confer any right on the applicant to be shortlisted or selected. The personal interview with the Selection Committee will be conducted through online mode. The services of the selected candidate will be governed by the provisions of the Maharashtra National Law University Act, 2014 and the Regulations framed thereunder. In case the selected candidate wishes to resign before completion of the contract period, they must serve one month's notice or pay one month's salary in lieu thereof. Since the post is residential in nature, the selected candidate must stay in the accommodation provided by the University on its campus. The University provides a free mess facility to the Campus Administrator during the operation of the mess in the academic year. The University reserves the right to disqualify any candidate who provides wrong information or submits false and fabricated documents at any stage.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at MNLU Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Campus Administrator on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Campus Administrator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree from a recognised University. Minimum 15 years of professional experience in defence, police service, or an equivalent administrative post in an educational institute is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Campus Administrator post?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 60 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must send their latest CV along with supporting documents via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications followed by a personal interview through online mode conducted by a Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of ₹80,000/- per month, along with Provident Fund, rent-free accommodation on campus, and medi-claim policy reimbursement, bringing the gross salary entitlement to approximately ₹1,00,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Do candidates who applied under the earlier notification need to apply again?
faq.answer: No, candidates who have already applied in response to the notification dated 08.07.2026 are not required to apply afresh.
